description: Allow ASK MARA TO HELP WITH a bounded authored remote object to become a real deferred promise before generic NOT-HERE actor confusion, without making remote objects generally accessible.

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE NOT-HERE-OBJECT-F ("AUX" TBL (PRSO? T) OBJ)
	 ;"This COND is game independent (except the TELL)"
	 <COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,NOT-HERE-OBJECT>
replacements.new:
<ROUTINE NOT-HERE-OBJECT-F ("AUX" TBL (PRSO? T) OBJ)
	 ;"Release 1277: a Mara help request may name one bounded real object elsewhere."
	 <COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,WINNER ,MARA>
	             <VERB? R1277-MARA-HELP>
	             <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,NOT-HERE-OBJECT>>
	        <SET OBJ <R1277-REMOTE-REQUESTED-OBJECT>>
	        <COND (.OBJ
	               <SETG P-CONT <>>
	               <SETG QUOTE-FLAG <>>
	               <R1277-MARA-REQUEST-OBJECT .OBJ>
	               <RTRUE>)>)>
	 ;"This COND is game independent (except the TELL)"
	 <COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,NOT-HERE-OBJECT>
